name: Liam Knott
source:
[i]"...I made her a promise when we were children, to protect her no matter what. And now, I need to make good on it."[/i]

[i]First Love's Martyr[/i]

The heroine's childhood friend. A boy from a wealthy family, and the very picture of friendliness. He's fair, kind, and boasts a gentle demeanor. That earnest behavior has earned him the deep trust of many, and he's also set to inherit the family business.

He harbors a faint affection for the heroine, and deeply worries about her safety as she recklessly pursues a dangerous path.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=liam]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
